integrity: Exact finite transfer-polynomial and rational spectral inequalities replayed; independent small-width direct simulation. Priority not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Proved only on two-row toroidal Moore quotients with eight offset incidences and lengths at least three; no basin or longer-period classification. Historical full text of 1990 account not obtained.
title: The period-three spatial zeta and entropy of Wireworld on two-row tori
